Welcome to MAMKramer/academic: Rethinking Intelligent Systems & Ecological Tech

Welcome to my digital academic notebook and research hub. I am Dr. Mark Anthony M. Kramer, an HCI researcher, system designer, and postdoctoral scholar at the Institute for Computational Medicine (Vetmeduni Vienna).

This site serves as a minimalist, central repository for my ongoing work at the intersection of Green AI, Green Computer Vision, Precision Livestock Systems, and More-than-Human (MtH) interaction design.

About This Portfolio

In alignment with my core research philosophy—that digital architecture should be materially responsible, low-footprint, and intentional—this portfolio is built to reflect those exact principles:

  • Lightweight & Fast: Built using a static site architecture to drastically minimize data transfer and energy consumption per page view.
  • Direct Access to Scholarship: Fast access to full-text research papers, teaching archives, and technical project notes without commercial tracking or unnecessary visual clutter.
  • Living Project Showcase: A dynamic space documenting hardware prototypes, edge AI implementations, and field study methodologies deployed in real-world agricultural and environmental contexts.

Current Research Streams

  • Green AI & Real-Time Computer Vision: Investigating methods to reduce energy consumption and computational overhead in computer vision and machine learning pipelines.
  • Precision Animal Health & Sensor Integration: Developing and testing non-invasive, hardware-based monitoring tools to augment veterinary care and farm management.
  • More-than-Human HCI: Designing sociotechnical interfaces that expand traditional human-centered frameworks to include animals, ecosystems, and planetary constraints.

Feel free to explore my latest Publications, review my Teaching Overview, or get in touch via email at mark@kramer.dev.
